summary.text: Opens the executive summary of the Persian translation, explaining that untreated CIN2 or CIN3 can progress to cervical cancer and that a screen-and-treat approach bases treatment on a screening test, using HPV testing, VIA or cytology, with cryotherapy, LEEP or cold knife conization as treatments.
